href: protocols/human/CB22. Percoll gradient lung tumor samples.html
title: CB22. Percoll gradient lung tumor samples
text:
Percoll separation to remove tumor cells from lung tumor samples. (CB22)
Materials:

Percoll 100% stock
HBSS-/-1x
R10 (RPMI 1640 + 10% FBS + 1% Pen/Strep + 1% Ultra-glutamine)
15 ml Falcons
50 ml Falcons

PERCOLL preparation

Use PERCOLL 100% (iso) for all subsequent dilutions: 18 ml PERCOLL stock + 2 ml PBS-/- 10x
PERCOLL 40% (per sample): 4 ml PERCOLL 100% (iso) + 6 ml R10
PERCOLL 70% (per sample): 3.5 ml PERCOLL 100% (iso) + 1.5 ml HBSS-/-1x

Protocol

Collect cells by centrifugation (10 min, 400g)
Resuspend cell pellet in 8 ml PERCOLL 40% and transfer to a new 15 ml Falcon tube
Stratify 4 ml PERCOLL 70% under the 8 ml PERCOLL 40% layer. NB: put firstly the 8 mL PERCOLL 40% then with 5mL pipette go to the bottom of the falcon and slowly stratify PERCOLL 70%.
Centrifuge at 790g for 30 minutes without brake (0)
Remove supernatant (leave 7 ml)
Collect the interface between the 30% and 70% PERCOLL (with a 5 ml pipette). Leave 1 ml of supernatant in the tube.
Transfer to a 50 ml Falcon tube and fill up the tube with HBSS-/- 1x.
Centrifuge at 400g for 10 minutes
Remove supernatant completely and resuspend the cells in the desired medium.

title: CB11.Disaggregation of human lung tumors
text:
Disaggregation of human lung tumors

Modified from “An optimized disaggregation method for human lung tumors that preserves the phenotype and function of the immune cells” Quatromoni JG et al, J of Leukocyte Biology 2015 and “Establishment and identification of human primary lung cancer cell culture in vitro” Si LL et al, Int J Clin Exp Pathol 2015.
NOTE:
After the lung tumor is surgically removed, it is placed in wash media: RPMI 1640 (Lonza) supplemented with 2% FBS (Sigma-Aldrich) and 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin (Euroclone) and brought immediately to the lab. Samples are processed within 60 minutes from removal.
Time:
1h and 30 minutes
Materials:

Petri dish
Scissors
Gentle MACS tube
70 μm Cell strainer
Sterile physiological saline solution (NaCl 0,9%. Baxter)/ 1X PBS /HBSS
Black rubber bottom of a 5 mL syringe
Falcons (50mL)
Trypan Blue 0,04%
Labelled Cryovials
Cryobox (RT)
Freezing Medium (FBS 10% DMSO 4°C)
Scales
GentleMACS dissociator (Miltenyi Biotech)

Protocol

Weigh and measure the tumor tissue
The tumor tissue is sliced into 1-2mm3 pieces by sterile microdissection by use of curved scissors
Mechanical disaggregation is performed with the Gentle MACS dissociator according to “01_02_lung” protocol set from the manufacturer (2 cycles are recommended at least). Addition of sterile physiological saline solution is suggested.
The sample is passed through a 70 μm nylon cell strainer. Gentle pressure is applied with the black rubber bottom of a 5 mL syringe to any remaining partially digested tissue on the cell strainer which was then washed with few mL of sterile physiological saline solution. NB: typically, <5% of the tissue (consisting of mainly acellular-connective tissue) remained on the strainer at the end of this step.
The sample is washed with 25 mL of sterile physiological saline solution.
The suspension is centrifuged for 15 minutes at 300 g at room temperature, max acceleration (9), max brake (9).
The supernatant is aspirated and if lot of erythrocytes are present, lysis is performed using 1X ACK lysis buffer (incubation with 5ml for 5min). The lysis buffer need to be diluted to 1X with sterile di-water.
Make up cell suspension to 30 ml with sterile physiological saline solution to inactivate the lysis buffer.
The cells are washed in sterile physiological saline solution and then counted in Trypan Blue 0,04%.
The cell suspension is centrifuged for 10 minutes at 520 g at room temperature, max acceleration (9), max brake (9).
The supernatant is removed and the cells are suspended in FACS buffer for staining or in cold freezing medium (FBS 10% DMSO 4°C) to 1 mL/vial
Vials are kept for 24/48h in a cryobox at -80°C, then moved to liquid Nitrogen container.

title: Human TIL Ex vivo Dynabead multiday stim
text:
Human TIL stimulation
Cell preparation

If using fresh TIL, see tumor digestion protocol
If using frozen TIL, see frozen PBMC protocol
After these steps, continue to protocol here

 
Anti-CD3/28 Stimulation

Prepare CD3/CD28 beads (Invitrogen Dynabeads Human T-Activator CD3/CD28) 

Vortex 30 seconds 
200 μL beads into 1.5 mL conical 
Add 1 mL FACS to wash
Vortex 30 seconds 
Place on magnet 1-2 minute 
Remove supernatant 
Add 200 μL of R10 to 200 μL beads (this can be done at varying amounts; resulting concentration beads:FACS is 1:1) 

Plate 1e6 cells per well in a 24 well plate
Supplement to 1 ml of R10 in each well
Add 25 ul of equilibrated CD3/CD28 beads to each well per 1 ml of R10. Mix thoroughly. *Make sure to include an unstimulated (no CD3/28 beads) control*
Incubate in 37°C incubator
At desired harvest time (48 hours later in this expt) remove cells from incubator 
Add Golgi Plug to each well of sample at 1 ul per ml of media. Add 5 ul of CD107a-APC antibody here as well because CD107a is internalized and needs to be added during stim for optimal staining. Pipette well up and down a few times and place back into the incubator
Incubate again at 37C for 4 hours
At end of 4 hours, collect cells from well by gently pipetting. Wash well 2x with 1 ml of R10 and add to cells.
Place cells + R10 on magnet 1-2 min to remove beads 
Aspirate supernatant (including cells; leaving beads behind) and transfer to clean flow tubes 
Wash flow tubes still containing beads 2x with 500 μL R10 each time, letting sit for 1-2 min 
Transfer R10 used to wash beads to new flow tubes containing cells
Discard tubes containing CD3/CD28 beads
Spin flow tubes with cells at 1500 RPM for 5 min 
Wash 1x with FACS
Transfer cells from flow tubes to 96 well plate

Surface Stain

Make surface antibody master mix in FACS. Make FMOs at this time.
Resuspend cells in 100 ul of surface stain master mix
Mix cells + master mix by light vortex.
Incubate cells for 20 min at room temp in the dark.
Wash 1x with FACS

L/D Stain

Wash 1x with PBS
Resuspend samples in 1 ml of PBS + L/D stain (made from -20 stock at a 1:1000 dilution)
Incubate cells for 10 min at room temp in the dark
Wash 2x with FACS

Cell Fixation and Intracellular TF and cytokine staining

Fix cells using 100 ul fixation buffer diluted 1:4 (i.e. 5 mls concentrate, 15 mls diluent) from eBioscience Foxp3 Transcription Factor Staining kit and resuspend thoroughly.
Incubate in dark at 4C for 20 minutes.
Wash with 100 ul 1x perm wash (from 10x stock).
Make intracellular antibody master mix in perm wash, using 1:100 for all antibodies, except Ki67, use 10 ul per sample of 1e6 cells (i.e. add 60 ul if doing three samples). Make FMOs at this time for: Granzyme B, IL2, TNF, IFNg, and Ki67.


*Hopefully unstimulated control can be used for these markers in the future, but unstimulated TILs may have residual staining for these markers, making the gate hard to make. If we see no differences between FMOs and unstim controls in these markers, we can definitely just use unstim control going forward!*


Resuspend cells in 50 μl intracellular stain and stain at RT or 30 minutes covered in foil.
Wash with 100 ul 1x P/W buffer, spin.
Rewash with 100 ul FACS, resuspend and run flow

title: Guava Instructions
text:
Guava User Instructions
Hello Guava users, if you use the Guava for any amount of samples (even ONE), you must clean the machine afterwards.
For a few samples (5 or less):
-A quick clean can be done after counting
For 5 or more samples:
-A long clean must be done after counting
Cleaning Solutions:
ICF: Instrument Cleaning Fluid (squeeze bottle with green cap)
Water: Please only use ddH2O
Following cleaning, please check that:
-The cleaning vial (clear tube with blue graphics) is filled with ICF to the fill line
-The waste vial (clear tube with red graphics) is emptied if it is filled past the fill line
If you are the last user of the day, please shut off the machine and the computer, after you are done.
Thank you,
Goldrath Lab

title: Moving mice from NSB to Pac Hall_ATM
text:
Procedure

Go to the NSB vivarium.
Turn the air and lights on in the bio hood.
Locate the mice that you want to transport and bring them to the bio hood.
Grab a clear plastic cage with the white bedding from next to the fume hood. You will need one for every cage that you have.
Bring or take a picture of the cage cards on the mice cages.
Put the mice into the clear plastic cages.
Close the clear plastic cages and put them into one of those big opaque garbage bags.
Go to Pac hall, put on PPE, and go to the Goldrath mouse room.
Grab waters, feeders, and cage card holders.
Put food in the feeders, and put it in the cage.
Put the water in the cage and put the sticker on the top of the water.
Add cage cards to the cages.
Put the cages on the rack. Make sure it clicks.
Change into new PPE and leave Pac hall.

title: Guava Protocols
text:
Before running, dilute the cells in RP5
Obtain a 96 wells plate, label accordingly.
Transfer 5µL of cells from step 1a into each well
Add 20uL of PBS into the same wells, making a 1:5 dilution factor

5µL cells:20vL PBS

Make 2x Guava master mix by diluting Guava solution in PBS

Calculate to make enough volume for 195µL total volume per sample

Prepare epi vials, in the vials combine 5µL of cell mixture from step 4 to 195µL of the Guava master mix for each sample

These vial samples will be used to run on Guava

title: Guava Protocols
text:
Running on Guava

Turn on the machine and computer, let the machine warm up for 10 minutes before use
On the computer, open the Guava software
Open “ViaCount” and “create a new data set”
Adjust settings:

PM1: ~750
PM2: ~800
These setting are approximate and can be readjusted.
PM1 should always be lower than PM2

Adjust parameters:

Dilution factor: 200
Original volume:

Spleen: 1mL
Other cells: 0.2mL

Events to acquire: 500-1000 events

After finished setting up, load the sample and click “Acquire samples”

Can stop acquire and “Next Sample” after 20s

Record “Total Viable Cells in Original Sample” number

title: Guava Protocols
text:
Cleaning

Determine which cleaning setting to use:

For few sample (<5 samples), use the quick clean option
For larger sample size (>5 samples), use the long clean option

Quick clean:

Fill an epi vial with ICF
On the acquisition page, click “quick clean” option and follow prompt

1 minute of ICF

After the cleaning is done, put diH2O back on and turn off machine and computer

Long Clean

Prepare cleaning vials

Vials are attached to the Guava machine on the bottom right.
Fill the cleaning (blue) vial with ICF up to the line
Discard liquids in the waste vial (liquid can go down the sink)
Reattach the vials back to the machine

Prepare 2 epi vials with new ICF and DiH2O, label and date.

These should be replaced every time you do a long clean
Can only use DiH2O

Go to the Guava software interface
Choose “cleaning” under “essential tool” in the main interface
Click “start cleaning” when the portal is opened and follow prompt

Load DiH2O and ICF accordingly

When the cleaning is done, exit the portal, shutdown computer and machine.

title: Imprint for Vivarium Cage Cards
text:
Imprint for Vivarium Cage Cards
We have 2 sets of Cage Cards:

NSB vivarium: yellow and blue
Pac Hall: Yellow and blue

In order to print/order the cards, there are 2 ways:

Directly go to Imprints to order:


UCSD Imprints - PrintConnection
printing@ucsd.edu
9500 Gilman Drive #0031
La Jolla
CA - California
92093-0031
United States

534-3020



Order online at PrintConnect:

https://ucsdimprints.myprintdesk.net/DSF/SmartStore.aspx#!/Storefront
To print from Imprint:

There’s a folder labeled “Imprints – Cage Cards Goldrath Lab” at the lab manager bench containing:

Order form
Sample cage cards
8.5 x 11 print of the cage cards pre-cut

Bring the folder over to Imprints and ask them to print according to the information outlined. Provide them the following information:

Index number
Mail code
Location: NSB 5106
Name
Cage card numbers

Provide them the final card size (3x5 HxW) and let them know to use the thickest paper stock they have as well as the final paper color you’ll need

Ordering from PrintConnect:

Go to: https://ucsdimprints.myprintdesk.net/DSF/SmartStore.aspx#!/Storefront
Create a profile with UCSDImprint
After a profile was established, go to home page and begin ordering
In the “featured products” section, choose “Standard Print & Copy” and select “Buy Now” in the pop-out box.
Provide the following information:

“Files”: upload the files you want printed (for cage cards, these can be found in the “imprint” folder in the “lab manager items” folder on the computer under the “8.5 x 11” labels)
“Job name”
“Quantity”: the amount of 1 single-sided 8.5 x 11 of what you wanted to print.

For Cage card, each 8.5 x 11 can be printed into 5 cards, so if you wanted 1000 cards, quantity would be 200

In “specifications” section:

Orientation: portrait
Print in color/sides: black and white: single sided
Media: pick the color for the materials you wanted printed:

For Breeder card: choose “Cover Index 90lbs Blue”
For Yellow card: choose “Cover Index 90lbs Canary”
Choose “8.5 x 11” as size for both

Cutting: choose “specific width and height” in the pop-out and input:

Width: 5 inches
Height: 3 inches

For “call to discuss/request proof/mailing list”, it is okay to choose either as needed
Special Instructions: put “use thickest paper possible”
No need to modify the rest of the options


Choose add to cart when finished and check out with appropriate index number or project number
For cage cards, make separate orders for the 4 separate card types.
